text:
Evelyn (Design): dropping a fresh pass for Lumen Ink dark theme. main asks: make chart series pop, fix inline code legibility, and unify action copy across console screenshots.

Marco (Frontend): paste palette pls so i can run the contrast util locally

Evelyn (Design): tokens: bg #061018, surface #0b1924, card #0e2230, primary #ffb36a, alt #63d8ff, tone #c8b3ff, low #94a3b4

Pri (Product): top-level: funnel and retention charts need clearer mid-series separation for A/B comparisons. primary/alt look fine solo but muddle when layered

Lucas (Design Eng): agree. alt (#63d8ff) collides with tone (#c8b3ff) in stacked views. can we shift alt slightly greener (#54e0c8) or nudge tone toward deeper mauve?

Jin (A11y): a11y flag: primary (#ffb36a) on card (#0e2230) is ~4.4:1 at 12px. legends are 11px on desktop by default. need >=4.5:1 for readable labels. prefer darker primary or larger legend text

Evelyn (Design): options: darken primary to #ff9f4a, or increase legend to 12px. mobile density is a concern if we bump text everywhere

Marco (Frontend): rendering-wise, color change easiest. darkening to #ff9f4a looks better in canvas. outlines/shadows are doable but hurt perf for busy dashboards

Lucas (Design Eng): i'll prototype #ff9f4a in storybook. also suggest legend swatch changes: desktop 16px -> 18px, mobile keep 14px. that gives scannability without raising label size

Pri (Product): that helps. but watch truncation in the left-rail list view on smaller widths

Evelyn (Design): plan: swatches desktop 18px, mobile 14px; labels unchanged; add long-press tooltip for mobile truncated items.

Jin (A11y): tooltips must be keyboard accessible too. also recommend focus ring: current 2px @ 30% alpha is faint on dark surfaces. propose 3px @ 0.6 alpha; add prefers-contrast solid fallback

Marco (Frontend): will add CSS var focus-ring: --focus-ring-width:3px; --focus-ring-alpha:0.6 and prefer-contrast fallback.

Evelyn (Design): inline code issue: inline tokens on surface read washed out. current inline color #ffd98a. idea: wrap inline tokens with subtle rounded bg rgba(255,217,138,0.07) plus 4px padding and 6px border-radius

Lucas (Design Eng): easy change, minimal perf cost. also code block bg currently #041219 which isolates blocks a lot. alternative: #071726 to feel more integrated with cards

Jin (A11y): code blocks: ensure token colors have sufficient contrast when copied into docs (light backgrounds). also scrollbars are barely visible on dark; add hover-visible thumb: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)

Pri (Product): copy consistency: console shows "Run" / "Execute" / "Start" across different flows. we should standardize. suggestion: "Run" for immediate actions, "Start" for multi-step flows, "Launch" reserved for infra-level jobs

Evelyn (Design): i'll make a copy table in the spec and push strings to the i18n file once decided.

Marco (Frontend): palette generation note: i'm onboard with algorithmic hue shifts for multi-series. suggest base +/- 14/28/42 deg and clamp S to 45-78% and L to 40-70% to avoid pastels that fail contrast

Lucas (Design Eng): i'll implement generator in chart util and include clamping. also add an opt-in flag for legacy dashboards to preserve old palettes

Jin (A11y): please add automated contrast checks in storybook: compute text contrast for legend labels and pairwise contrast for series colors; flag pairs under 3:1 for graphics and 4.5:1 for text. fail CI for critical dashboard stories

preview-bot: generated preview -> /comms/preview/2189123456/lumen-ink-v1.png

Evelyn (Design): preview looks close. @Jin can you run a quick sweep on the preview?

Jin (A11y): running now 50d found two legend pairs below AA for 11px. will add inline comments in the Figma frames with suggested hue deltas (+8deg, -6deg)

Pri (Product): timeline: need tokens frozen by EOW for marketing screenshots. is that doable?

Lucas (Design Eng): estimate: theme token updates + CSS vars 1 day, chart generator + tests 2 days, a11y fixes 1 day. target freeze in 4 working days.

Evelyn (Design): i'll update the spec with final tokens, generator rules, inline code styles, legend swatches, and the copy table. will post updated assets here when ready. thanks everyone :sparkles:
